description: The developer's payout account (Stripe Connect), needed to sell products inside their apps. One account per developer, for all their apps, unless a project has its own (neblla_projects "use_own_stripe"): pass projectId to act on that project's account instead; every action below works the same on it. "onboarding_link": the neblla.com page where Stripe's own onboarding opens inside the developer's Neblla session (no app: the account serves all their apps), where they verify identity and add a bank account (a human must do it; bank details and documents are collected by Stripe there, never in the chat, and Neblla never sees them); the first time it opens the account and fills in what Neblla knows (email, studio name, the studio page as the web, the statement prefix). A developer who already uses Stripe signs in with it there to reuse their details; it is still a new account of theirs. Paid products waiting for the account publish by themselves once it is active. "dashboard_link": the developer's own Stripe Dashboard (payments, payouts, refunds, disputes, taxes); they sign in with their Stripe login. "set_descriptor" { prefix }: what the buyer's bank statement says before each app's name, «PREFIX* APP» (2-10 Latin letters or digits; Neblla proposes the studio's short name). Only when the developer asks. The account is the developer's: Stripe's fees, refunds, disputes and any negative balance are on it, not on Neblla. "disconnect" stops Neblla selling on their behalf and HIDES every paid product from users; the Stripe account itself is kept, so reconnecting later returns to the same one. It needs confirm: true. Products stay hidden from users until the status is active. Commission: Neblla takes 1 % of each sale, before tax; Stripe's own fee is separate and paid by the developer's account (the charge is made there: the developer is the seller). The actions that only look (status) are in neblla_payments_account_read.

prefix.description: set_descriptor: the bank statement prefix, 2-10 Latin letters or digits

projectId.description: A project with its own Stripe: its payout account. Omitted, or a project using the account's: the developer's.
